core_obligations: Rewrite one side (proof lines 7037-7039): the companions give that the cohomology on the coarser site of the pulled back object equals the cohomology of the derived pushforward of the pullback.

Degenerate the spectral sequence (proof lines 7039-7055): the spectral sequence with second page given by the higher direct images of the cohomology sheaves converges to the cohomology of the derived pushforward, and hypothesis (V_n) kills all terms with 0 < p <= n and 0 <= q <= n, leaving only the terms with p = 0; hence the comparison map from the object to the derived pushforward of its pullback is an isomorphism in degrees at most n.
Conclude (proof lines 7055-7057): substituting the identification of the two cohomologies gives the displayed isomorphism in degrees at most n.
proof_roadmap: Use the unbounded Leray result to replace the cohomology on the coarser site by the cohomology of a derived pushforward.
Analyse the second page of the spectral sequence and use hypothesis (V_n) to kill every term with positive p in the range considered.
Read off that the comparison map is an isomorphism in degrees at most n.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the cohomological counterpart of the comparison of higher direct images: under the comparison situation and hypothesis (V_n), the cohomology on the coarser site of the pullback of an object of A_X agrees with that of the object itself in degrees at most n (statement lines 7028-7035). The proof is a complete spectral sequence argument: the unbounded Leray result identifies one side with the cohomology of a derived pushforward (proof lines 7037-7039), the spectral sequence is displayed, hypothesis (V_n) kills all terms with positive p in the relevant range so that only the terms with p = 0 survive (proof lines 7039-7055), and the comparison follows (proof lines 7055-7057). The non-formal content is the vanishing bookkeeping on the second page. The claim is H2: a displayed spectral sequence with the vanishing input used explicitly.
